newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bonds to drift back then push to 113-09.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bonds to drift back then push to 113-09.

text.p: September T-bond futures look set to consolidate on Monday before another push higher in the next few weeks towards 113-09, technical analysts said.
"It's not dramatically overbought, but I think it will stall for now," said Elli Gifford, an independent technical analyst near Cambridge. "Some consolidation would be useful."
She put important support at 111-08. "Providing that holds, we could see the rise extended in due course, but we're right on my target for the time being," said Gifford.
By 0855 GMT, September T-bonds were up 1/32 at 111-28, off an earlier high at 111-30.
Gifford said over the next few weeks the market would try to take out the February 18 peak at 113-09 and ultimately aim for around 114-08, a Fibonacci projection level.
She said if 111-08 gave way, further support at 110-09 would kick in. Charts show the contract hit a daily high of 110-09 on May 13.
Analysts at MCM YieldWatch said the market was undergoing a near term correction from Friday's 112-02 high, but agreed losses would be limited ahead of gains to 112-16, then the 113-09 February high.
"Loss of 111-01 warns of a deeper correction to the 110-16 area," they said in a note.
By 0857 GMT, September Eurodollars were down 0.005 at 94.135.
